item_name: Rothco Police Supreme Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Show your pride in law enforcement with Rothco’s Police Supreme Low Profile Insignia Cap. Crafted from soft brushed cotton twill, this cap ensures all-day comfort, whether on duty or off. The bold “POLICE” embroidery on the front panel adds a professional touch, while the low-profile design offers a sleek fit. Equipped with a padded sweatband, this cap helps keep sweat away for enhanced comfort during active wear. The adjustable hook and loop closure ensures a secure fit for most head sizes.
